title: Local well-posedness of the higher-order nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the half-line: the case of two boundary conditions
summary: We prove the local Hadamard well-posedness of the higher-order nonlinear Schrödinger equation with negative dispersion coefficient on the half-line under nonzero Dirichlet and Neumann boundary data. The paper uncovers a striking feature of this model: unlike the positive-dispersion case studied in (Alkın, Mantzavinos, Ozsari, 2024), well-posedness requires two boundary conditions rather than one.
